title: Reality Check Shipped A Thrilled Single Track, "OREAD"
htmlContent:
Reality Check has created something special with "OREAD" — a unique mix of styles that will surely be a hit on radio and streaming services. Reality Check is a US-based hip-hop and R&B artist. Their new single, "OREAD," is a unique blend of energetic hip-hop, indie, and EDM sounds. It's a fun, vibey track that will get you in the mood to dance and have a good time. Whether it's a club night or just you in the car, this song will keep you groovin'.
